name: Obadiah
lede: The thirty-first book of the Bible, in full: the vision of Obadiah concerning Edom — thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, though thou set thy nest among the stars; the day of thy brother's calamity; the day of Jehovah near upon all the nations; and saviours on mount Zion, and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Clefts of the Rock
books.blurb: The vision of Obadiah: an ambassador sent among the nations against Edom; the pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock — though thy nest be set among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence; the violence done to thy brother Jacob in the day of his calamity; as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; the house of Jacob a fire, the house of Esau stubble; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's.
